definitions: Hard, solid non-metallic mineral matter of which rock is made.
A small piece of rock found on the ground.
A unit of weight equal to 14 pounds (6.35 kg).
A piece of precious or semi-precious stone; a gem.
The hard seed in the middle of some fruits.
examples: The wall is made of stone.
He threw a stone into the river.
A ring set with a blue stone.
Remove the stone from the peach.
